sql: SELECT TOP 10 gc.UserId AS userId, COUNT(DISTINCT gc.GiftCardId) AS voucherCount, MIN(gc.Name) AS firstNameAsc, MAX(gc.Name) AS firstNameDesc, MIN(gc.CardNumber) AS firstNumberAsc, MAX(gc.CardNumber) AS firstNumberDesc, MIN(gc.StartDate) AS firstStartDateAsc, MAX(gc.StartDate) AS firstStartDateDesc, MIN(gc.ExpirationDate) AS firstExpirationDateAsc, MAX(gc.ExpirationDate) AS firstExpirationDateDesc, MIN(gc.Amount) AS firstAmountAsc, MAX(gc.Amount) AS firstAmountDesc, MIN(gc.RemainingAmount) AS firstRemainingAsc, MAX(gc.RemainingAmount) AS firstRemainingDesc FROM dbo.ZnodeGiftCard gc INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = gc.PortalId WHERE po.StoreCode = @store AND gc.UserId IS NOT NULL AND (@owner IS NULL OR gc.UserId = @owner) GROUP BY gc.UserId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gc.GiftCardId) >= @minVouchers AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.GiftCardId) <= @maxVouchers ORDER BY gc.UserId
